name: Frostbreath
description: A spear of solid ice imbued with an icy chill. It is said that it once belonged to the Belyi Tsar who ruled Snezhnaya in the distant past.

refinements.description: Triggering a Cryo or Hydro-related elemental reaction increases the equipping character's ATK by 20% for the next 15s, as well as regenerates 6 Elemental Energy for other members of their party. This effect can trigger once every 16s.
